# Cross-Sections

Living, hand-drawn 3D cutaways of great buildings and machines, in the tradition of 1990s cross-section picture books. Static web app: three.js scenes drawn through an ink and watercolour pass, with people on hour-by-hour routines, live slicing, day and night, and a synthesised soundscape.

## Read

- README.md: what it is, how to run and explore it, what the checks establish.
- AGENTS.md: rules for contributors and agents.
- docs/ENGINE-API.md: every engine call a scene can make.
- docs/SCENE-GUIDE.md: art direction, quality bar and process for a scene.
- docs/research/<id>.md: research dossiers with sources, one per subject.
- src/scenes/lighthouse.js: a complete small scene to copy.

## Do not

- Parse dist/cross-sections.html; it is generated and minified. Read src/.
- Use Math.random, network assets or recordings in a scene.
- State facts in captions that the dossier's sources do not support. Named characters are fictional.
- Use em dashes.
